N_seq.what: negative control for the sequential protocol: frames in random order (random.Random(f'seqnull|{dataset}|{score}|{draw}').shuffle(sorted keys)); each frame keeps or negates all its scores with probability 1/2 (random.Random(f'seqflip|{dataset}|{score}|{draw}'), one draw per frame in shuffled order); labelling stops when m = 10 frames are informative; v1.1 run once (seed = draw index)
N_seq.outcome: share of draws read in either direction; descriptive, no criterion
